Map accuracy & connections ＋

Both diagrams are hand-traced. Level Two was corrected for photo perspective and rotated 90° to align the three lift shafts and enclosed stairwells with Level One.

Blue and teal paths show walking on each floor. The dashed bridge shows a lift or stair transfer in the separated-floor view; it is not a corridor through open air.

Three lifts, two central stair routes and two enclosed stairwells are linked. Stair landing positions and travel distances are inferred and need on-site verification. The northern small stair on Level Two has no confirmed destination and is not linked.

Level One’s unclear northern-room doors and enclosed-stair access remain closed. A route from the hall can use central stairs or lifts. Stairwell voids and flights are blocked to ordinary floor movement.

“u” means illustrative plan units, not surveyed metres. Storey height and display separation are illustrative. Lifts-only routing does not certify accessibility or lift availability.

A* searches a two-floor grid with explicit transfer links. Shortest mode minimises modelled distance; clearance mode trades extra distance for more space around obstacles. No live positioning is included.
